entries.notes: Tonic/vocative 'a tté'.
Metaphonic gender pair: m. jìdde, f. jédde.
Accent distinguishes nú 'we' from nu 'a'.
Plural for both genders: le (i, li). 'u cane' / 'le cane'.
Reduced to 'a after a noun before a possessive: la màchen'a mé.
Plural indefinite: dò ('some, a couple of').

entries.meaning_it: questo / questa / questi (pronome o aggettivo tonico)
entries.notes: Barese has a two-way system: cùsse (near speaker/hearer) vs cùdde (far).
u cùdde / la chèdde 'the one (already mentioned)' is used contrastively.
stu file, sta màghene, sti uagnùne.
Shows nd > nn.
Ce uè? 'what do you want?'; ce v'a ddùrme sùbbete... 'if you go to bed early...'.
Ci jè? 'who is it? / what's up?'. Many sources write ce for both.
u sacce ca jè nu bbuéne uagnóne 'I know he is a good lad'.
City Barese prefers non, nan is widespread in the province; final n causes sandhi: nan bozze 'I can't'. 'No' as answer: none.
Accented to distinguish from pronoun mé.
pe nnudda nudde 'not at all'.
Comparative: chiù + adj + de.
Barese has no partitive article: nu picche de...
mo mo 'just now'; mo ppùnde 'right now'.
From Latin cras.

entries.meaning_it: tre giorni fa (il giorno prima dell'altroieri)

entries.notes: Locative fusion: 'ngàse 'at home', 'mmàghene 'in the car'.
da mo nnanze 'from now on'.
City form (Ce sta asselúte na fresóle); the province often has sckitte instead.
Also used as plural indefinite article.
Triggers doubling: che ttè 'with you'. Articulated: c'u, che lla.
pe ccolpe de 'because of'; doubling: pe nnù.

entries.meaning_it: essere. Presente: so', sì, jè, sìme, sìte, so'
entries.meaning_en: to be. Present: so', sì, jè, sìme, sìte, so'
entries.notes: Also first auxiliary for 1st/2nd persons in the present perfect.

entries.meaning_it: avere come ausiliare e 'dovere' (avé a + infinito); presente: àgghie, è, à(ve), àmme, avìte, ànne/ònne
entries.meaning_en: to have (auxiliary) and 'to have to' (avé a + infinitive)
entries.notes: Lexical possession uses tené. avé a + inf. also expresses future.
Tènghe u prìisce; le corne ca tìine; tène la suste.

entries.meaning_it: fare. Presente: fazze, fasce, fasce, facìme, facìte, fàscene
entries.meaning_en: to do, to make. Present: fazze, fasce, fasce, facìme, facìte, fàscene

entries.meaning_it: andare. Presente: vògghe, va, va, sciàme, sciàte, vonne; p.p. sciùte
entries.meaning_en: to go. Present: vògghe, va, va, sciàme, sciàte, vonne; past part. sciùte
entries.notes: vògghe a + inf. = 'I go and...'.

entries.meaning_it: stare. Presente: stògghe, sta, sta, stàme, stàte, stònne
entries.meaning_en: to stay, to be (located); progressive auxiliary
entries.notes: Progressive: stògghe a ffà 'I'm doing'; 2sg/3sg take an inflected verb: sta a pparle 'you're talking'.
3sg/2sg present also dìsce.
Non ze véde u trène 'the train can't be seen'.

entries.meaning_en: can, to be able (pòzze, pùte, pòte...)
entries.notes: non (ze) pòte tirà nnanze acchessì 'one can't go on like this'.

entries.meaning_en: I want (vògghie), you want (uè), he wants (vóle); veléve = I'd like
entries.notes: Conditional is replaced by the imperfect: Veléve scì o cìneme 'I'd like to go to the cinema'.
From Latin ad-captare.
nù stame a ffadegà ddó 'we're working here'.
pl > chi.
la màghena mé jè dda scettà 'my car is ready for the scrapheap'.

entries.meaning_en: to take a worry off someone's mind
angry, on bad terms with someone

examples.translation_it: Nicola è in lite con Michele.
examples.translation_en: Nicola is on bad terms with Michele.

entries.notes: Metaphonic plural; vocative uagliò.
Vocative mà; enclitic possessive màme-te 'your mother'.
attàne-me 'my father'.
capa tòste 'stubborn/dull', malàte de cape 'reckless'.
Iàbbre l'ècchie! 'take care'.
à 'mmane à 'mmane 'little by little'.
'ngàse = 'at home' (locative).
Contrast pèsce 'worse' (accent marks vowel quality).
Attested in 12th-century parchments according to the source.
From French boîte.

entries.notes: Called the most Barese word of all.

examples.translation_en: Don't go to Vituccio now, he's in a mood.
